plainText:
Goh's Dewgong (Japanese: ゴウのジュゴン Go's Jugon) is the fourteenth that Goh in the Kanto region, and his twenty-third overall.

==History==
=== ===
 
 debuted in A Test in Paradise!, where Goh caught it while he and were on their way to Dragonite Island. Though it was a hard Pokémon to catch, costing Goh all of his Poké Balls, Goh finally caught Dewgong and officially added it to his team. Goh and Ash then rode across the sea on Dewgong, but during their journey, Dewgong spotted another Dewgong, fell in love with it, and chased after it, ignoring Goh's requests to stop. This led the group into a storm, which separated Dewgong from its Trainer.

Later, after being unable to find the other Dewgong, Goh's Dewgong reunited with its Trainer just as he and Ash were about to leave Dragonite Island to follow a group of Dragonite that had just left. Dewgong gave Goh and Ash a lift to the Dragonite, just in time to see one of them being captured by .

In A Snow Day for Searching!, Goh sent Dewgong out to explore a lake where a group of had dropped a 's bone in. With Dewgong being part , it was unaffected by the cold water while exploring the lake. Eventually, Dewgong found the bone and retrieved it.
 
In Panic in the Park!, Dewgong was one of the Pokémon affected by the disappearance of food at the Cerise Park. When the group led by Goh's Scyther and subsequently clashed, Dewgong began leading Goh's other Pokémon to join the fight. When went out of control, Dewgong helped the other Pokémon rescue Goh's three and allow them to evolve safely.
 
In Getting More Than You Battled For!, after being attacked by a while looking for , Goh used Dewgong to save himself and Ash. Despite this, they encountered a waterfall ahead and fell from it, forcing Goh to recall Dewgong.

In On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!, Goh entered Dewgong in the Kids Marine Athletic Race. Goh crossed the finish line, but Dewgong got distracted on seeing a group of being chased by a and went to intervene. Huntail attacked Dewgong, Chloe, and , leaving them trapped in a cave before being rescued by Ash's Dracovish. One of the Gorebyss came over, and Dewgong fell in love with it, only for Gorebyss to be more interested in Huntail, leaving it heartbroken.

In Breaking the Ice!, Goh used Dewgong along with and , Chloe, and Regina's Pokémon to create an ice playground for his classmates. Using along with Regina's , Dewgong managed to create a huge structure made of ice that Arctozolt transformed into a castle.

In Looking Out for Number Two!, Goh used Dewgong to find a as part of his second Trial Mission for Project Mew.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Dewgong attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.
 

==Personality and characteristics==
Dewgong was a hard Pokémon to catch in A Test in Paradise!. In fact, Goh had to use up all of his Poké Balls to accomplish this task. Dewgong appears to be the leader of the Cerise Park's Pokémon, with the other Pokémon joining the fray Panic in the Park! only after Dewgong takes the lead. It is quick to fall in love, which often leads to it ignoring its 's commands and frequently getting in trouble in the process. Despite running off frequently, Dewgong is still loyal to Goh.

Goh appears to prefer Dewgong for activities that involve swimming. Like other members of its species, it can withstand ice-cold winter waters, and is strong enough to carry its Trainer, , and while swimming unhindered.
